title: Sharing: Your Soul’s Intention
fullTitle: Soul Feast #9: Sharing: Your Soul’s Intention
description: In today’s soul feast, Gary Zukav expands on the concept of harmony, from the previous episode, and introduces another key intention of the soul – sharing . Moving beyond the idea of simply exchanging words or gifts, he redefines sharing as an act of deep connection, grounded in love and free of any agenda .
Gary reflects on his own journey, including how his personal experiences have shifted his understanding of generosity, making sharing an act of the soul rather than the personality .

He emphasizes that to truly connect with others, we must look within, using emotional awareness to guide whether we’re acting from love or fear. He offers a practical “soul step” exercise: carry a small journal and record moments when you’ve shared authentically, and when you’ve shared with an underlying desire for validation or recognition.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Carry a small notebook with you daily to capture moments of sharing. After each experience, take a moment to reflect: Was your intention truly grounded in love, or did it carry an element of fear or self-interest? By practicing this awareness, you’ll gain powerful insights that help you align more deeply with your soul’s intention to share and to create authentic power.
